purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Uşak

queries.query: Uşak cadastral parcel map official TKGM Parsel Sorgu
queries.result: First-party discovery identified TKGM's official Parsel Sorgulama service and the official Uşak cadastral directorate listing. The public viewer exposes a current MEGSİS API host in its JavaScript configuration.

Türkçe first-party discovery reached TKGM Parsel Sorgulama and the TKGM Denizli Bölge Müdürlüğü bağlı müdürlükler page, which explicitly lists UŞAK KADASTRO MÜDÜRLÜĞÜ/UŞAK and UŞAK TAPU MÜDÜRLÜĞÜ/UŞAK.

registryEvidence.custodian: UŞAK KADASTRO MÜDÜRLÜĞÜ/UŞAK and UŞAK TAPU MÜDÜRLÜĞÜ/UŞAK, listed by TKGM Denizli Regional Directorate.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: The official TKGM page identifies the local cadastre and land-registry offices. This establishes local registry custody, not runtime adapter admission.

parcelDiscovery.source: TKGM Parsel Sorgu / MEGSİS public API
parcelDiscovery.nativeIdField: composite source identity from pafta, mahalleAd, adaNo, parselNo
parcelDiscovery.crs: GeoJSON coordinate order is longitude, latitude; API response did not declare a formal CRS, so EPSG:4326 is treated as an observation/inference only.

boundedResponse.requestScope: Exact WUP point, no coordinate shift
boundedResponse.result: Public anonymous coordinate query returned one polygon and safe cadastral attributes.

parcelDiscovery.note: The retained sample has exactly one canonical id property. Native fields and composite-key provenance are recorded here and in the service review, not in GeoJSON properties.

requestOutcomes.outcome: Current official viewer HTML retrieved; it loads main.js?v=76.3.
Viewer JavaScript retrieved; app/util/constants.js identifies https://cbsapi.tkgm.gov.tr/megsiswebapi.v3.1/api as the API host.
Anonymous JSON FeatureCollection retrieved; province schema uses properties text and id. Uşak appears with id 86.

Exact WUP point query returned one GeoJSON Feature with Polygon geometry and safe fields including ilAd Uşak, ilceAd Merkez, mahalleAd Kurtuluş, adaNo 97, parselNo 516, pafta K22-C09-D-1-A, alan, nitelik, and durum.

schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: Not declared in response; coordinates are visibly GeoJSON longitude/latitude and are retained unchanged.
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: No single explicit id property was returned. Stable identity is a source-proven composite of pafta + mahalleAd + adaNo + parselNo.
schemaAndCrs.compositeKeyProvenance: K22-C09-D-1-A|Kurtuluş|97|516 was composed directly from returned native fields; no synthetic row number was used.

qualification.reason: A real public source and bounded anonymous geometry response are evidenced; adapter/runtime qualification remains held for independent serial review.

scopeLimits: One exact-point response is not citywide coverage evidence.
A map extent, timeout, login wall, or unusable UI would not establish citywide absence; none was treated as such.
No raw source-specific attribute set or unsafe property data was retained.
Packet completion is research completion only and is not source integration or admission.
uncertainty: The response schema and geometry were observed from the current public viewer/API, but formal CRS metadata and citywide coverage were not independently established.
